extension.summary: Scrobble your Kodi playback to Sesn
extension.description: Automatically log what you watch in Kodi to your Sesn account (sesn.io) — a simple, private TV, film and anime tracker. Sends only the title/ids, position and your key; never your library or file paths. Live TV is never scrobbled.
extension.news: 0.2.11 - Safer sending: stops after Sesn rejects the key and asks you to pair again; drops events Sesn refuses; backs off up to 30 minutes when Sesn is unavailable and honours Retry-After; queued events expire after 7 days; only https Sesn addresses are used; gentler pairing and sync polling. 0.2.10 - Disconnect now revokes this device's key on sesn.io, not just on the box. 0.2.9 - Correct parent-show identifiers for episodes; register Kodi pairing in Connections; validate scrobble acknowledgements.
